input.name: image
input.range: [0, 1] grayscale, same preprocessing as baseline_encoder.json (luma, square crop, bilinear resize); full image spans the field of view

output.name: amplitude_ua
output.meaning: stimulation amplitude per electrode (microamps), electrode order as in electrodes.json

postprocess: Apply the safety layer (clamp to [0, max_current_ua], keep top max_active_electrodes), zero electrodes with alive == 0, then render with electrodes.json's formula.
runtime: onnxruntime-web (wasm backend); operator list per model under models[].onnx_ops
